name: Covered box with foliated sides
dimensions: with cover: H. 6.8 x Diam. 15.8 cm (2 11/16 x 6 1/4 in.)
summary: Large circular box and cover with matching foliated sides; white stoneware with transparent colorless glaze over pressed foliations. From northern China, probably from Hebei or Henan province.
